authorization: PM explicitly changed this resumption to a readonly sampling shell script uploaded under /tmp, executed, collected and removed; old contract/tag remains historical and unchanged.
transport: sdb/26101 only; remote RC/DONE/FAIL; no SSH, no root on
allowed_board_writes: Only uniquely named /tmp/pf_20260916_<hex>.sh sampling scripts; hash check before execution/removal; captured output streams directly to host, no board result files; delete own scripts and verify absence on every exit path.

identity.hard: kernel must not contain rpi4; architecture must equal armv7l; OS must be Tizen10/TV product image, not unified-toolchain/development
identity.kernel_history: 6.12.60 family is reference, deviation recorded not automatically rejected
identity.vk_send: presence is supporting evidence, absence recorded without veto; never invoke it

baseline: package-manager availability and RPM database path/writability; no installation test
inventory: Whole-system process view including PID 1, all readable live userspace smaps ranked by old heuristic; exact named candidates plus top 10; unknown visibility or live unreadable smaps stops and records authorization-needed items; process exits reported, never zero-filled.
sampling_clock: Board /proc/uptime monotonic deadlines at available resolution; date +%s%N read timestamps. Parallel readonly PID and global reads per slot. Record sample acquisition intervals; any batch finishing at/after next deadline stops with partial data, no invented rows.
required_observations: Historical glibc-heap/other-anon/file-backed PD buckets, total PD, minflt/majflt, PID/start_ticks, MemAvailable, zram first three mm_stat bytes and swaps used. Missing required fields, process identity change, remote proof failure or malformed rows stops; absent zram is not zero.
capacity_boundary: Read-only permission and installed-package metadata are not proof that future install/attach is permitted; never run RPM transaction, gdb attach or ptrace probe.
analysis: Unchanged analyze_floor.py and historical release_ratio_census thresholds, absolute/first-minute/last-minute floor definitions; passive observation not equal to historical activity-induced increments or free-bin bytes.
failure: Stop new diagnostic/sampling actions on any hard gate failure; only bounded cleanup of this attempt's own scripts remains authorized. No retry or completed-window rerun.
publication: Raw host board_results; redacted compact data/raw; report retains historical stops. Push main only, no demo changes.
